evidence: Homepage grid lists 8 heritage cards (spring-festival, dragon-boat, paper-cutting, peking-opera, kunqu-opera, chinese-calligraphy, suzhou-embroidery, yixing-teapot) and listing.results shows "共 8 个非遗项目" matching the count.
Card for spring-festival shows title (春节), category badge (民俗活动), region (北京 · 华夏大地), and brief description (春节是中国最重要的传统节日...) plus a 了解详情 link.
Filter select options are exactly: 传统工艺 (Traditional Crafts), 传统表演 (Performing Arts), 民俗活动 (Folk Activities), 传统美术 (Traditional Art). All 8 listed items use one of these four categories.
Clicking suzhou-embroidery hotspot opened panorama.overlay with image, category (传统工艺), title (苏绣), region (江苏 · 江南水乡), brief description, and 查看详情 (view details) link to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery.

actual: The panorama UI advertises "拖拽旋转" (drag to rotate), but performing real trusted mouse drags (Playwright dragTo) across large distances (viewer center to nav.logo, viewer center to zoom buttons) as well as synthetic mouse/pointer event sequences produced zero change in the scene's rotation transform (stayed exactly "rotateX(0deg)") and zero change in hotspot left/top percentages (identical to 4 decimal places before/after). Rotation cannot be performed at all, so a full 360° rotation and hotspot wrap-around cannot be achieved. Zooming in/out, by contrast, does work (scale changes 1→1.2→1.4) and hotspots that momentarily go out of the visible set at high zoom (4→2 hotspots) do reappear when zooming back out, so zoom itself does not permanently lose hotspots, but the core rotate-through-360 requirement fails.

evidence: On /heritage/suzhou-embroidery, gallery has 3 selectable thumbnails. Thumbnail 2 has a broken/unavailable source and renders a placeholder icon instead of an img; selecting it updates the main image area to show explicit failure text "图片加载失败" with an icon. Selecting thumbnail 1 or 3 correctly swaps the main image to that image (e.g. alt="苏绣 - 3" with matching src) and marks the corresponding thumbnail as active/selected.

Detail pages (e.g. /heritage/peking-opera, /heritage/suzhou-embroidery) show matching title (京剧/苏绣), full multi-sentence introduction, category (传统表演/传统工艺), region (北京·京城古韵 / 江苏·江南水乡), inclusion year (2010年入选 / 2006年入选), and a gallery of 3 images with thumbnails.

Checked images across multiple heritage items (spring-festival, suzhou-embroidery, peking-opera, dragon-boat): each item has its own distinct set of image URLs (no cross-item duplication observed) with alt text tied to the item's Chinese name (e.g. "端午龙舟 - 1", "京剧 thumbnail 2"), indicating images are assigned per item rather than randomly shared/mismatched.

Navigating to /heritage/peking-opera and /heritage/suzhou-embroidery each open the correct matching item's detail page. Navigating to an invalid id /heritage/nonexistent-item-xyz shows only heading "未找到该非遗项目" (project not found) with a "返回首页" link and no unrelated project content; clicking it correctly navigates back to the homepage.
On /heritage/kunqu-opera, clicking "浏览更多项目" (browse more projects) navigated to http://localhost:6063/#categories, landing back on the homepage with the full listing.grid of 8 project cards visible.

Search "苏" narrowed 8→2 items with count "共 2 个非遗项目" matching. Adding category filter 传统工艺 further narrowed to 1 item (苏绣), count updated to 1. Clearing search and filtering province=江苏 showed 3 items (kunqu-opera, suzhou-embroidery, yixing-teapot), count=3. Changing sort from 按名称/按年份 (order: kunqu, suzhou, yixing) to 按地区 reordered the same 3 items (suzhou, yixing, kunqu), confirming sort changes ordering while count/filter stay consistent.

With filters set to province=江苏 and sort=按地区 (region), opening 苏绣's detail page and navigating back (browser back) restored the homepage with the same filters still applied: province select shows 江苏, sort shows 按地区, result count "共 3 个非遗项目", and the same 3 items in the same order (suzhou-embroidery, yixing-teapot, kunqu-opera).

In panorama view, zoomed to scale(1.2), opened the 苏绣 hotspot overlay, clicked 查看详情 to /heritage/suzhou-embroidery, then clicked 返回全景探索. Back on the panorama, the scene transform was restored to exactly scale(1.2) rotateX(0deg) translateX(0px) (same as before leaving), and the 苏绣 overlay (title/category matching) automatically reopened, restoring the hotspot state that was active before navigating to the detail page.
